jobs.occupation: Senior Product Marketing Manager (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Marketing)
jobs.description:
Short DescriptionSPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. We work with companies like Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes, Bosch, Stadler, and Rheinmetall. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia / General Catalyst, and Salesforce.

In this role, you own how SPREAD is positioned, messaged, and understood by engineering leaders at enterprise accounts. You translate a deeply technical product into narratives that win deals, arm Sales with competitive intelligence and enablement assets, and partner with Product and Engineering on go-to-market. This is a hands-on role in a small, senior marketing team alongside Growth, GTM Ops, and Design.
Your Mission
• Own positioning and messaging for SPREAD's platform, turning engineering intelligence into value propositions that land with top engineering leaders.
• Build and maintain competitive intelligence across the PLM and engineering data landscape and turn it into battle cards and objection-handling guides that Sales uses daily.
• Create sales enablement assets that shorten enterprise sales cycles and improve win rates.
• Partner with Product and Engineering on go-to-market for product releases, connecting every launch to a measurable customer outcome.
• Develop thought leadership content that builds credibility with deeply technical audiences.
• Partner with Growth and GTM Ops on campaign messaging and account targeting so demand gen speaks the right language to the right pain points.
• Represent SPREAD at industry events and customer conversations where engineering leaders expect a peer-level discussion about their domain.

Your Experience
• 5+ years in B2B product marketing or technical product management for enterprise software or complex technical products, with hands-on ownership of positioning, messaging, and go-to-market.
• Technical fluency through an engineering or technical degree, or through deep experience managing or marketing highly technical products. You can hold a credible conversation about data architectures, PLM tool landscapes, or software-defined product development.
• Experience building sales enablement for complex enterprise deals (€100K+ ACV, 6-12-month cycles, multi-stakeholder buying committees).
• Strong competitive intelligence instinct. You track competitors, articulate differentiation in the buyer's language, and prepare sales teams for live objection handling.
• AI-native working style. You use AI tools daily to scale your output, from content creation to research to workflow automation. SPREAD is an AI-first company, and every team member operates accordingly.
• Identity as a product marketer. You partner with Product and Engineering, you speak their language, but your craft is marketing, not roadmaps or feature specs.
• Native or near-native English. Working-level German minimum. If German is your native language, strong English is sufficient.
• Based in Berlin or close enough for regular in-office collaboration, especially during the first months.

Why SPREAD?
• Work on Agentic Engineering Intelligence that helps leading manufacturers master software-defined complexity. You market technology that engineering leaders genuinely care about.
• High ownership and measurable impact. You connect your positioning directly to deal outcomes and pipeline.
• A senior team that values craft, speed, and accountability over process and hierarchy.
• Strong overall package including attractive compensation and an annual learning budget.
• Mobility and wellbeing support through a Deutschlandticket mobility budget, bike-leasing and an Urban Sports partnership.
• Time off and flexibility with 30 vacation days, workation options, and one paid volunteering day per year.

ContactDmytro İefymenko recruiting@spread.aiSPREAD AIKöpenicker Str. 40c | 10179 BerlinStay connected—follow us on LinkedIn for the latest insights and updates

About usSPREAD is pioneering Agentic Engineering Intelligence . Our low-code platform transforms fragmented hardware and software product data into dynamic Product Twins , creating an AI-ready knowledge base that powers smarter decisions and automation across the entire product lifecycle.
At the heart of our technology lies the world’s first Universal Engineering Information Model (EIN) — a semantic framework that connects domain-specific and lifecycle data into a federated Engineering Intelligence Graph , continuously evolving over time. This foundation enables specialized AI agents to execute tasks like compliance checks, dependency analysis, and specification generation — seamlessly integrated into the tools engineers already use.
The impact is tangible: companies using SPREAD achieve up to 10x faster time-to-market , 50% lower lifecycle costs , and significantly higher product quality .
Industry leaders such as Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Rheinmetall , and others rely on SPREAD to build the next generation of software-defined products.
Headquartered in Berlin, SPREAD delivers enterprise-grade security (ISO 27001 & TISAX), full GDPR compliance , and flexible deployment options — in the cloud or on-premises.

Our Vision
The future of engineering is data-driven and agentic . We make product data the most accessible, intuitive, and impactful resource in engineering — so that engineers can unleash their full creativity and drive innovation at scale.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer in Production [Mid-Senior; F/M/D] (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
About us Global protein consumption is skyrocketing—especially meat.
And that’s creating massive challenges for health, climate, and
animal welfare. At Project Eaden, we’re tackling this head-on with
our patented fiber spinning technology: plant-based meat with
authentic texture and taste. Our LEKKA products are already in
millions of homes across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Your
mission If you're a mechanical engineer and want to apply your skills
to food production technology, this is your chance to develop
innovative mechanical systems for plant-based meat manufacturing, this
is your chance to take the next step and take operational
responsibility. Join us now as we scale operations in a fast-growing,
purpose-driven startup. Key responsibilities Machinery Installation &
Commissioning: Support installation of new food processing equipment,
perform commissioning and validation procedures, and conduct
functional testing to ensure proper operation before production use.
Continuous Modification & Improvement: Analyze existing processes and
equipment performance, identify improvements, and design modifications
to increase efficiency, reliability, and food safety compliance.
Implement optimizations in the production environment. Equipment
Repair & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical,
integrated and pneumatic equipment failures. Troubleshoot complex
issues in mixers, conveyors, industrial machines, and automation
equipment. Implement timely repairs to minimize production downtime.
Mechanical Design & Process Optimization: Build and test mechanical
prototypes and operational processes, validate design performance
through testing and prototyping, iterate designs based on production
feedback and food safety requirements. Cross-functional Collaboration:
Work closely with production, R&D and quality teams to optimize
equipment performance and resolve complex production challenges.
Communicate equipment status and maintenance needs to production
planning and leadership. Technical documentation: Develop and maintain
comprehensive technical documentation including S.O.P.s, schematics,
mechanical drawings, process diagrams, and system specifications.
Vendor & Contractor Management: Manage relationships with external
vendors, contractors, and service providers. Coordinate procurement
activities, oversee contractor performance, and ensure project
deliverables meet specifications. Your profile In this role, you'll be
responsible for designing custom food processing equipment, developing
mechanical solutions for plant-based protein manufacturing, and
supporting the mechanical engineering needs of our production
operations. As a hands-on mechanical engineer, you'll work on
everything from equipment design to production support. Requirements
Professional Experience: 5-8 years of mechanical engineering
experience in production or manufacturing environment, preferably with
exposure to food processing, manufacturing equipment, or automated
systems. Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical
Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or
related technical field. Strong foundation in equipment maintenance,
reliability engineering, and manufacturing processes. Knowledge of
food industry applications preferred. Technical Skills: Knowledge of
manufacturing processes and production optimization techniques,
familiarity with lean manufacturing principles. Strong troubleshooting
abilities with hands-on experience developing mechanical solutions and
diagnosing and repairing mechanical equipment failures. Proficiency
with CAD software, process modeling tools, and manufacturing software
systems. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving
abilities with experience in root cause analysis and process
troubleshooting. Ability to interpret production data and develop
longlasting cost effective engineering solutions. Operational Agility:
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to adapt
quickly in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. Language
Proficiency: Fluency in English and/or German, with professional level
in the later, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Why us? Why you should apply now Scaling Big: We’re at an exciting
inflection point, transitioning from a pilot phase to scaling
operations. Be part of something transformative and build it from the
ground up. Top-Tier Backing: We’re supported by world-class VCs and
angels who share our vision and believe in our mission. The Time is
Now: Food needs a massive transformation. Join us in creating
irresistible, sustainable food that inspires billions to switch away
from animal-based meat, fast! A word on Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
We embrace diversity and equal opportunities for all. Shared values
and alignment with Project Eaden’s purpose matter most to us. We
welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age,
color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation,
gender identity, or marital status. Workspace and culture We’re
building something massive—a gentle giant in the food industry. Our
team thrives on collaboration, and we believe in the power of
face-to-face communication to move fast and work effectively.
Currently, we spend most of our time together at our workplace in
Berlin to nurture our team spirit and culture. As we grow over the
next few years, we aim to evolve into a more distributed workplace,
blending the flexibility of remote work with the strength of our
shared values and connection.

jobs.occupation: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

jobs.occupation: Field Sales Engineer – Central EMEA (Technical-Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Role overview

Altera is seeking an experienced Field Sales Engineer to drive growth across an assigned territory in the Central EMEA region. Depending on the candidate’s background and the business need, the role may focus primarily on either:

- Growing territory coverage, distribution customers, and channel-partner design wins; or
- Developing a defined set of strategic customers through focused demand creation and account initiatives.

The successful candidate will combine technical credibility, commercial drive, and strong relationship-building skills to turn customer and market opportunities into sustainable revenue growth.

Job responsibilities

- Develop and execute sales plans to achieve or exceed assigned revenue and design win targets.
- Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities, including early-stage demand creation and design-win activity.
- Manage and grow customer accounts and, where applicable, distribution partners through strong multi-level relationships.
- Own the broader commercial relationship with strategic customers and channel partners, including pricing, contractual terms, volume commitments, supply expectations, and issue escalation.
- Understand customer needs and position Altera’s products and solutions effectively.
- Prepare and deliver sales presentations, product demonstrations, technical proposals, and business cases.
- Drive opportunities through the sales cycle, from prospecting and technical engagement through design win, negotiation, and closure.
- Build joint business plans with channel partners or account plans with strategic customers, depending on the assigned focus.
- Collaborate closely with field application engineering, applications engineering, marketing, product management, and product development.
- Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline data, opportunity plans, and customer information in the CRM system.
- Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and market conditions to identify opportunities and risks.
- Represent Altera at customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and partner activities.
- Travel regularly within the assigned territory in Central EMEA.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
- At least five years of successful experience in technical sales, field applications, account management, or a comparable customer-facing role, preferably in semiconductors or embedded systems.
- Demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding sales targets.
- Strong understanding of FPGAs, SoCs, and related hardware and software design flows is highly preferred.
- Experience with distribution partners, channel ecosystems, strategic accounts, or technology-driven customer programs.
- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
- Strong customer-development, opportunity-management, forecasting, and CRM skills.
- Self-motivated, proactive, commercially minded, and results-oriented.
- Proficiency with CRM systems such as Salesforce and Microsoft Office or comparable tools.
- Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken, is required.

Willingness to travel frequently within the assigned territory in Central EMEA.

jobs.occupation: RDT Business Partner (m/w/d) RDT Pharma International (Informationsmanager/in)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Let’s build a healthier future, together. In the role of RDT Business Partner at Roche Digital Technology (RDT) / Informatics, you will make a decisive contribution to turning our vision "Doing now what patients need next" into reality. You are part of RDT Pharma International and belong to the RDT Business Partner team at the preferred location in Grenzach. Here, we combine technological innovation with commercial goals to continuously improve patient care through digital solutions and actively shape the healthcare ecosystem.

Responsibilities | What awaits you

In this role, you will take responsibility for the strategic connection between Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and the assigned business functions to advance Roche's strategic goals through groundbreaking technology solutions. In addition, you will take on the following exciting tasks:
* Stakeholder Management: You act as a trusted strategic partner and advisor to business leaders, co-create technology-enabled strategies, and proactively drive global process improvements.
* Bridge between Local & Global: You bundle the local requirements of the business functions (Commercial, Finance, P&C, Supply Chain, etc.), advocate for local needs at the global level when necessary, and conversely bring global standard solutions effectively to Germany.
* Innovation & Impact: You specifically identify business opportunities and work closely with Product Leads to design, prototype, and continuously develop innovative technological capabilities.
* Complexity Management: You are accountable for the successful delivery of technology-enabled business outcomes (such as annual revenue goals or patient access) for commercial areas.
* Problem Solving: In strong partnership with Product Engineering Teams, you are responsible for the escalation and targeted resolution of complex, systemic challenges.
* Technology Focus: As a Key Opinion Leader, you drive the technological vision forward, manage stakeholders end-to-end, and scale pilot solutions to maximize their added value.

Qualifications | Who you are

For this demanding interface role, you bring sound IT knowledge, strong business acumen, and excellent communication skills:
* Education: Successfully completed Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master’s degree or MBA is a plus.
* Professional Experience & Industry Knowledge: Sound experience participating in IT projects within complex matrix organizations as well as strong business acumen in the pharmaceutical / life sciences environment.
* Partnership & Moderation: Proven track record of building trusted relationships across different organizational levels (including management level), as well as strong competence in conflict management and moderating complex interfaces.
* Language & Communication Skills: You bring excellent communication skills (fluent/negotiating-level English for collaboration in a global environment as well as very good German skills for daily interaction at the Grenzach site).
* Working Style & Presence: High flexibility, strong analytical skills, and systems thinking, as well as the willingness for on-site presence at the Grenzach location.
* Teamwork: Strong ability to collaborate constructively in cross-functional, agile teams and to actively promote appreciative cooperation.

Duration: This position is a temporary assignment limited until January 2028.

Your Application

We ask you for a current CV and your official (educational) certificates/proofs. 

Further documents are currently not mandatory. Please note before submitting the application that no further documents can be added afterwards. 

Apply now – we look forward to meeting you!

 

 

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you need further support?

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.occupation: Senior Product Manager (BAD Product) (m/f/d) (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Are you looking to own the customer-facing experience for JetBrains products, from how individuals and organizations buy and manage software to how licensing and entitlements work behind the scenes?

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll lead the strategy for BAD (Business Application Development) Product. You’ll tackle the complex web of purchases, subscriptions, organization administration, and usage-based services, making sure our customers have a smooth, coherent experience every step of the way.

You’ll work closely with engineering, design, analytics, QA, and BAD Platform, as well as Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams. You’ll have the autonomy to drive product discovery, validate hypotheses through data and experimentation, and define the long-term vision for our licensing and administration ecosystem.

Day to day, you will:

- Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for BAD Product systems.
- Uncover user friction through customer research, support data, telemetry, and feedback from internal teams.
- Map and improve end-to-end customer journeys covering purchasing, subscriptions, licensing, and administration.
- Identify gaps, overlaps, and inconsistencies across sub-systems to build a clear, unified user experience.
- Partner with engineering, design, analytics, and QA from early discovery through launch and continuous iteration.
- Define and track key product metrics for adoption, conversion, and support demand.
- Communicate product direction, trade-offs, and progress clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

What you’ll bring

- An ownership mindset, taking responsibility for outcomes, not just task completion.
- A clear focus on underlying problems and desired outcomes rather than immediate feature requests.
- Comfort with technical complexity, trade-offs, and systems thinking.
- A preference for quality, long-term sustainability, and user trust over short-term fixes.
- The ability to make grounded decisions using customer research, analytics, and experimentation.
- Strong collaboration skills across multi-disciplinary teams and distinct business areas.

What you’ll need

- A proven track record of managing technically complex SaaS, enterprise, or B2B product areas end to end.
- Hands-on experience driving product discovery, user research, and roadmap prioritization.
- Experience navigating complex customer journeys, multi-team dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Experience making data-informed decisions using telemetry, product metrics, and experimentation.
- The ability to work comfortably alongside engineering teams on technical details, APIs, data models, and system integrations.
- Fluency in English.

What success looks like

In practice, success means building a licensing and administration experience that feels seamless to the user and resilient under the hood. You'll bring clarity to ambiguous systems, simplify fragmented customer flows, and establish reliable product metrics. Ultimately, you succeed by removing friction for millions of developers and admins, allowing them to focus on their actual work.

Why join JetBrains?

- Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
- Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
- Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
- Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
- Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
- Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to read your application.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

jobs.occupation: Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware Production (Qualitätsmanager/in)
jobs.description:
html Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware ProductionTaufkirchen, Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee

Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.

More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware Production
Taufkirchen, Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

THE WHY

At Blackwave, we develop and manufacture Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels and carbon fiber structures for the space industry — hardware where failure is not an option. As we scale from one site in Germany to two with our new facility in Texas, quality can't be an afterthought or a paper exercise. We're looking for a Quality Manager who builds a pragmatic, ISO 9001-compliant Quality Management System from the ground up for our Texas site, keeps our German QMS sharp, and creates a quality culture that engineers, operators, and management actually live — not one that gathers dust in a document folder.

THE WHAT

- Own ISO 9001 at both sites: Maintain certification in Germany and establish it in Texas, preparing all audits — internal, certification, and customer — together with the teams so they're passed without major findings. Blackwave Code: High Performance
- Build processes people actually use: Define and implement essential quality processes that are pragmatic and scalable enough for development, manufacturing, and management to apply confidently in daily work. Blackwave Code: Togetherness
- Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor
- Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: Accountability
- Digitize quality: Establish a digital QMS platform as the mandatory system of record, with quality documentation and workflows fully migrated and adopted across the organization. Blackwave Code: Playfulness

YOUR PROFILE

- 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office
- Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management
- Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end
- Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy
- Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity
- Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator
- Fluent English is a must; German is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER

- Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.
- Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.
- Coffee Culture @ Blackwave: Enjoy premium coffee from our portafilter machine or join one of our barista courses.
- Choose Your Perk: Select from a Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a Give Card.
- Gear up for Take-off: Receive premium Blackwave team apparel during your on boarding.
- Grow in Aerospace: Expand your professional horizons in a high-growth company at the forefront of space technology.
- Rooftop Relaxation: End your day on our spacious rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Alps.

Please refer to reference number YF-51680 for your application.

Apply for this job
